items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I think that little fella, three years ago when I was in Chicago, with Sharky, I saw that same little Jewish guy

ctx.x: So then when did y'all catch on?

Well, uh, down the street, in the middle of the block, was the, uh, I'd say, I think it was Cones Grand Opera House. That was big time Waterville. And Bert Swann and Charlie Mack came to town. And so they came over there to hear this jazzy band. Incidentally, that's where that word jazz came from. Ah. Jazzy band. Clangy, jazzy, anything. Who put it on y'all? Do you remember? Well, who knows? It just grew up around Randolph and York. Were you in Chicago before y'all? No, no. They didn't even know how to spell it.…
